punchline: Holiday was a student as an apprentice, then had to choose it all over again once he was an executive.
thirty_sec: Ryan Holiday left college to apprentice under Robert Greene, then rose fast to an executive job at American Apparel. The company's crises and his own ambition showed him that success had not made him wiser: the more approval he got, the harder it was to admit mistakes. That break became the starting point for his book on ego.
